title: Natural-clothing brands
summary: Four dark-pants options · 100% natural main fabric · price-first comparison.

recommendation.title: Better material disclosure—with fit compromises
recommendation.text: No exact slim 30×32 match verified. Rawganique can be hemmed; Uskees is tapered but has a 31″ leg.
recommendation.test: Harvest & Mill is the cheapest, but it is loungewear. None of these four is independently verified plastic-free throughout.

caveat: These are specialist natural-clothing brands, not verified wholly plastic-free brands. Organic and natural-fiber labels do not establish health benefits or absence of all finishes. No verified influencer endorsement of these exact pants was found.
evidenceNote: Exact color/size variants and prices checked October14. Shipping quotes are anonymous single-item estimates to NYC10016, not full-address checkout guarantees. Tax, hemming and possible returns add cost. Uskees shipping remains unquoted. This is an exploratory comparison, not four complete fit matches; community durability and independent certification checks remain incomplete.

sources.title: View Rawganique · Hemp Slacks · selected size
sources.type: Brand specification and exact live variant
sources.note: Best near-match: black 30x33 available; needs hemming to 32. Straight, not slim. Final sale. Sewing thread and zipper tape composition unreported, so whole-garment plastic-free NOT verified. Two metal hooks; brass zipper; tagua nut or coconut buttons. Thread, zipper tape, pocket lining not specified on product description. Manufacturer claims no heavy metals or harsh chemicals; no named third-party certificate or certificate number on exact product evidence. No independent validation. Product-specific care: hand wash/flat dry or dry clean; no dryer. Manufacturer 99.2%-biodegradable label is not a full plastic-free guarantee.

sources.title: Rawganique · returns / delivery
sources.note: Anonymous ZIP10016 cart: $89.97 item + $16.90 shipping = $106.87 before tax. Closeout final sale: no refund. Use stricter product-specific terms.

sources.title: View Uskees · 5005 Workwear Pants · selected size
sources.type: Brand specification and exact live variant
sources.note: Exact offered waist size 30W, but fixed leg is 31 inches, not requested 32. Tapered leg, mid-rise; page warns runs small and size up if between sizes. Closest structured everyday trouser here, but shorter and expensive in US market. Plant-based corozo buttons; front zip fly and lined adjustable waistband. Zipper tape, thread, lining and label composition unspecified, so synthetic trims remain possible. Organic-cotton workwear specialist; exact 5005 page states 100% organic cotton. Whole-brand or whole-garment plastic-free status not established.
